body.statement: If \(T=\{a,b\}\), then \(D_T(p)=u+v\) and \([L_T(p),U_T(p)]\) is exactly the Balke--Pearl binary-exposure envelope evaluated on the two target cells while all remaining exposure mass is unrestricted. If \(|\mathcal E|=3\) and \(T=\mathcal E\), the two nuisance-category pieces reproduce the published Gabriel--Sachs--Sjolander ternary formulas. If \(T=\mathcal E\) for arbitrary finite \(\mathcal E\), the interval is the pairwise ATE projection of the fully valid categorical-IV model characterized by Song et al.
body.justification: The reductions enforce comparator fidelity and the required binary and ternary sanity checks.
body.gap: The reductions are known separately, but their simultaneous appearance as boundaries of one selected-trust formula must be verified algebraically.
body.consumer: Existing binary and ternary software can use these equalities as regression tests for the arbitrary-support evaluator.
